why: Look at the small square: it sits top-left, top-left, bottom-right, bottom-right, so next it goes back to top-left (it stays for two figures, then jumps). The small circle moves one corner clockwise, then stays, then moves again: top-left, top-right, top-right, bottom-right, so next it stays at bottom-right. Option 1 has the small square at top-left and the circle at bottom-right. Option 4 has the circle at bottom-left and the square at bottom-right, so it is wrong.
trick: Track each small object separately, one corner at a time. Look for a 'move, stay, move, stay' rhythm and extend it one more step.
note: Medium square position varies slightly between figures and is treated as noise; small square and circle carry the rule.
